Review.title: Review
Review.description: Public website review and rating submitted by a user of SQA Quiz Pro.

authorName.description: Display name or nickname of the reviewer.

comment.description: Written review comment or good luck message.

quickTag.description: Quick sentiment tag selected by the reviewer.

isPublic.description: Flag indicating whether the review is publicly visible.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the review was created.

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Collection of public community reviews displayed in the website footer.
